_comment_header: TENTIAL (325A) DCF overrides. Source: FY2025/8 Tanshin (7-month irregular period 2025-02-01 to 2025-08-31, transition from Jan-end to Aug-end), prior FY2025/1 (12-month 2024-02-01 to 2025-01-31), and 1H FY2026/8 interim (6-month 2025-09-01 to 2026-02-28). All figures JPY mn. Single brand D2C (BAKUNE recovery wear + bedding + sandals), consolidated direct revenue forecast, NOT SOTP.
_comment_market: Market data fallback for when yfinance is unavailable. shares_outstanding approx from market cap / price; treasury stock (625mn) repurchased in 1H FY2026. generate_dcf.py re-applies these over any yfinance value. VERIFY exact share count from securities report.
_price_note: 3,500円 = 概算（出所: 各種株価サイト 2026-06。ユーザーが板で要確認）
_comment_historical: IMPORTANT FISCAL-PERIOD NOTE: FY2025/8 is a 7-MONTH irregular period (Jan-end to Aug-end transition). It is NOT comparable to the 12-month FY2025/1 without annualization. For DCF base-year purposes we annualize FY2025/8 (x12/7) to get a normalized 12-month run-rate. hist_years below labels each period explicitly. Revenue / OP / COGS / SGA / NetIncome / DA / Capex from Tanshin PL & CF.
_hist_revenue_note: FY2024/1=47.35e (estimate, prior 12m). FY2025/1=12,837 actual 12m. FY2025/8=11,134 actual but 7m only (annualized x12/7 = 19,087). FY2026/8E=30,200 company forecast (full 12m, +158% vs 7m / approx +58% vs annualized prior). VERIFY FY2024/1 from securities report.
_comment_base_year: Base year = FY2025/8 ANNUALIZED (x12/7). Revenue 11,134 x12/7 = 19,087. COGS 3,052 x12/7 = 5,232 (COGS% 27.4%). OP 1,167 x12/7 = 2,001 (OP margin 10.5%). Using annualized run-rate as base to avoid 7-month distortion. ALTERNATIVELY use FY2026/8E forecast 30,200 as base if you prefer forward-looking start.
_comment_nwc: NWC base from 1H FY2026 interim BS (2026-02-28). AR=accounts receivable (売掛金) 801, INV=inventory (商品) 4,861 -- VERY HIGH, ~150+ days, key risk, AP=accounts payable (買掛金) 217+other payables 1,069. Using AR=801, INV=4861, AP=1069.
_comment_scenarios: HYBRID design tied to thesis. Base = growth decelerates from current high pace but stays strong (store expansion confirmed on-ground, product横展開 to bedding/sandals). Upside = 2024-problem-style wellness tailwind + new category success, SGA leverage kicks in. Management = company plan FY2026/8 +58% (annualized base) tapering. Downside1 = BAKUNE saturation + MTG/competitor pressure. Downside2 = brand obsolescence + inventory write-down risk (INV is 4,861mn). COGS% ~27-30% (high gross margin D2C). SGA% is the swing factor: declines with scale in upside, stays high (ad/store costs) in downside. dih_days HIGH (~150) reflecting heavy inventory.
_comment_capex_da: DA% ~1.3 and Capex% ~1.8 of revenue (FY2025/8 annualized: DA 114x12/7=195 on rev 19,087=1.0%; capex 126x12/7=216=1.1%). D2C asset-light (EC + some stores). Inventory is the heavy working-capital item, NOT capex. revenue_pct method.
_comment_tax: Tax rate statutory ~31%. Profitable company (positive net income all recent periods), so effective tax near statutory. No major carryforward concern.
_comment_wacc: User-style inputs consistent with prior models: risk_free 2.3%, ERP 6.0%, size_premium 4.0%. Beta 1.3 (D2C consumer discretionary, brand-driven; lower than SpiderPlus 1.45 as less B2B-capex-cyclical but ADJUST 1.2-1.5 if preferred). Cost of equity = 2.3 + 1.3*6.0 + 4.0 = 14.1%.
_comment_debt: Net cash position. Interest-bearing debt ~357 (1yr-portion long-term 136 + 1yr bond 11 + long-term 210) at 1H FY2026 interim (2026-02-28), cash 2,458 => net cash ~2,101. de_ratio tiny. NOT EDINET-derived (avoid narrow-taxonomy trap, manual per prior learning).
_comment_terminal: Terminal growth 1.5% (Japan long-run). Exit multiple EV/EBITDA 12x (D2C/consumer brand mature multiple, more conservative than SaaS). For TENTIAL profit is positive so EV/EBITDA Exit is meaningful (unlike SpiderPlus). But still cross-check with EV/Sales given growth.
_comment_v3: Primary multiple = EV/EBITDA (TENTIAL is solidly profitable, OP margin ~10-13%, so EBITDA-based multiples are stable and meaningful -- unlike near-zero-profit SaaS). Cross-check EV/Sales against high-growth D2C comps with growth-normalization (comps span MTG high-growth to others decelerating).
investment_thesis: 1. Category-defining D2C wellness brand: BAKUNE recovery wear leads the recovery-wear category (1M+ sets sold), expanding横展開 into bedding and sandals; on-ground store rollout accelerating (confirmed across 5 cities)

2. Growth re-accelerating: 1H FY2026/8 revenue 16,471mn (half-year already exceeds prior full 12-month FY2025/1 of 12,837), OP margin recovered to 13.3% from the 9.3% dip; high product quality drives repeat/brand pull
3. Healthy finance: net cash ~2,101mn, conducting share buyback (625mn) signaling management confidence; high gross margin (~73%) D2C economics
key_risks: 1. Inventory risk: inventory ballooned to 4,861mn (from 1,795mn), ~150+ days; durable if growth continues but a write-down/markdown risk if growth stalls (single-brand concentration amplifies this)
2. Competition & brand saturation: MTG (ReD/ReFa recovery wear, JAL/ANA adoption), Phiten, VENEX, Workman entering recovery-wear; BAKUNE could saturate or face price competition

3. Single-brand / consumer-discretionary cyclicality: heavy dependence on BAKUNE franchise; SGA (ad/store) intensity pressures margins during expansion (margin dipped to 9.3% in 7m period before recovering)
